doc: float32 lon and lat give float32 output (all the trigonometry in float32, not in float64). The poles (float32 pi/2 is 1.5707964 > pi/2, so cos = -4.4e-8, not 0), the antimeridian and unreduced angles (1e3, 100.5) are included. Measured against the float64 evaluation of the same float32 inputs: 7.2e-8 at most; the golden.store default (1e-5 rel, 1e-6 abs) is more than 10x that.
